title: Mini Israel · Entrance and workshop

buildingCutout.basis: Replace only the mapped main entrance/workshop body identified in the PMTiles and the aerial photo. Keep the independently mapped visitor buildings.

note: The stepped workshop outline matches the large footprint beside the information point and approach. The gate faces the visitor approach, toward the northwest. The precise opening positions, pavilion height and rear openings are reconstructed from photographs. The retained Terrarium rises across the workshop. Stepped building volumes and buried foundation skirts follow that terrain. The entrance slab is anchored near the sampled front path. The exterior heights are approximate. The asset represents the park’s full-size entrance and workshop. Other visitor buildings and miniature exhibits are separate components.
